description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeesSearchForm class, which extends the SearchForm class to provide specialized search functionality for employee records within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to construct a search form from an existing form and to generate a customized search WHERE clause with specific filters for active users and visibility controls.

classes.name: EmployeesSearchForm
classes.description: A subclass of SearchForm tailored for employee search functionality, adding filters for active status and visibility controls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new EmployeesSearchForm instance by constructing a parent SearchForm with data from an existing search form.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Generates an array of WHERE clauses for the search query, applying filters to include only active employees and exclude portal/group/hidden users.
